name: pulp
description: Self-hosted reader app for Obsidian literature notes

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulp/shared && npm run build -w @pulp/server && npm run build -w @pulp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pulp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pulp/server && npm run typecheck -w @pulp/web
